# Extra Scoop Documentation

> Technical and product documentation for Extra Scoop, an institutional media network connecting eyewitnesses with newsrooms through hardware-backed capture, automated authenticity verification, and cryptographic licensing.

* Platform: https://extrascoop.app
* Newsroom Terminal: https://terminal.extrascoop.app
* Eyewitness iOS App: https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/extra-scoop/id6760804538
* Documentation Hub: https://docs.extrascoop.app
* Full Unabridged Compendium: https://docs.extrascoop.app/llms-full.txt?v=latest

## Introduction

- [Platform Overview](https://docs.extrascoop.app/introduction/overview): High-level system architecture, operational phases from capture to broadcast delivery, core subsystem definitions, and user journeys.
- [Platform Glossary](https://docs.extrascoop.app/introduction/glossary): Canonical definitions for core terminology including Silicon Trust™, Digital Deeds, Trust Scores, Smart Escrow, Concord Dealroom, Deed Vault, Ephemeral Messenger, Provenance Invariance, and C2PA Manifests.

## Verification Architecture

- [Silicon Trust™ Architecture](https://docs.extrascoop.app/concepts/silicon-trust): Multi-stage verification pipeline incorporating synthetic media and deepfake detection (still image frequency analysis and video temporal/biological consistency), automated dealroom quarantine, neural watermarking with forward error correction, C2PA manifest injection, and the Provenance Invariance raw file purge guarantee.
- [Digital Deeds & Provenance](https://docs.extrascoop.app/concepts/digital-deeds): Standardised legal ownership instruments anchored to the Base layer-2 blockchain and decentralised IPFS storage, establishing legal title, chain of custody, and commercial licensing terms.
- [Trust Scores & Verification](https://docs.extrascoop.app/concepts/trust-scores): Dynamic credibility ratings computed from hardware device attestation (Apple Secure Enclave), spatial/temporal metadata consistency, synthetic media analysis, and creator track records.
- [Smart Escrow & Settlement](https://docs.extrascoop.app/concepts/smart-escrow): Automated commercial settlement engine locking newsroom bidding funds (£5.00 minimum to £1,000,000.00 maximum) and executing instant payout to creators upon mutually agreed terms.

## Eyewitness Mobile App

- [Eyewitness App Quickstart](https://docs.extrascoop.app/eyewitness/quickstart): Mobile application setup, security PIN configuration, biometric unlock, source privacy controls, reporting roles (Witness, Field Reporter, Truth Seeker), and dynamic recommendation engine adaptation.
- [Capturing Verified Footage](https://docs.extrascoop.app/eyewitness/capturing-footage): In-app camera operation, hardware attestation metadata extraction, GPS coordinate verification, LocalForage offline queueing, and Blind ID source privacy.
- [The Dealroom & Bidding](https://docs.extrascoop.app/eyewitness/dealroom-bidding): Receiving incoming newsroom offers, evaluating Exclusive Commercial Licences versus Syndication rights, submitting counter-proposals, and accepting terms within live countdown timers (3m, 5m, 10m, 30m, 1h).
- [Payouts & Stripe Connect](https://docs.extrascoop.app/eyewitness/payouts-stripe): Connecting bank accounts via Stripe Express, monitoring available balances and lifetime royalties, and executing biometric-authenticated payouts.
- [Ephemeral E2EE Messenger](https://docs.extrascoop.app/eyewitness/ephemeral-messenger): Zero-knowledge source confidentiality channel engineered with ML-KEM 768 (Kyber) post-quantum key encapsulation, RSA-OAEP 2048, AES-GCM 256, Apple Secure Enclave P-256 signatures, a strict 15-minute RAM-only session lifetime (64 KB maximum envelope size), and deterministic memory noise wiping.

## Newsroom Terminal

- [Newsroom Terminal Overview](https://docs.extrascoop.app/terminal/overview): Desktop command centre for broadcast wire desks and investigative editors featuring Workspace Columns, Grid Feed, and Deed Vault modes.
- [Workspace Columns & AI Search](https://docs.extrascoop.app/terminal/workspace-columns): Multi-stream beat monitoring, OmniCommand search with multi-tier latency caching (Tier-0 edge in-memory cache <1ms, Tier-1 semantic vector cache, and AI intent compilation), Boolean query operators (AND, OR, NOT, trust:>N, #hashtag), and acoustic alert triggers.
- [Concord Dealroom & Licensing](https://docs.extrascoop.app/terminal/concord-dealroom): Evaluating verification reports, placing commercial bids (£5.00 min to £1M max with 3m/5m/10m/30m/1h expiry presets), negotiating terms, and executing atomic escrow locks.
- [The Deed Vault](https://docs.extrascoop.app/terminal/deed-vault): Permanent legal and compliance archive for inspecting cryptographic Merkle anchors, verifying Base layer-2 receipts, and downloading uncompressed master broadcast files.
- [Wire Format Exporter](https://docs.extrascoop.app/terminal/wire-exporter): Broadcast package exporter generating IPTC NewsML-G2 XML (compatible with BBC ENPS, AP Newsroom, Reuters Connect) and newsroom CMS JSON webhooks with commercial licensing enforcement.

## Developer Hub

- [API Authentication](https://docs.extrascoop.app/developer/api-authentication): Authenticating programmatic requests to the Extra Scoop Edge API using Bearer JWT tokens, with runnable cURL, TypeScript, and Python code examples.
- [Model Context Protocol (MCP)](https://docs.extrascoop.app/developer/mcp-server): Connecting Claude Desktop, Cursor, and autonomous AI newsroom agents to the live intelligence wire via native MCP tools (search_scoops, get_scoop_details, synthesize_briefing, make_offer).
- [Webhooks Integration](https://docs.extrascoop.app/developer/webhooks): Subscribing to asynchronous platform events (escrow.locked, deed.anchored, media.ready, scoop.verified) with timing-safe HMAC-SHA256 cryptographic signature verification.
- [Errors & Rate Limits](https://docs.extrascoop.app/developer/errors-and-limits): Standard HTTP status codes, structured JSON error response payloads, rate limit headers, and backoff guidelines.

## Canonical Platform Glossary Table

| Term | Definition |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Silicon Trust™** | A layered provenance framework combining synthetic-media screening, hardware attestation, and cryptographically signed manifests to guarantee the integrity of breaking news media. |
| **Digital Deed** | An immutable ownership certificate anchored to the Base layer-2 blockchain and decentralised storage, establishing legal title, chain of custody, and commercial licensing terms. |
| **Trust Score** | A dynamic reputation rating computed from multi-factor verification signals, hardware attestation, and community consensus. |
| **Smart Escrow** | An automated settlement mechanism locking enterprise bids (£5.00 to £1,000,000.00) in secure custody and executing instant payout upon licence acceptance. |
| **Concord Dealroom** | An institutional negotiation interface enabling verified newsrooms to submit commercial bids, propose custom terms, and acquire exclusive media licences directly from eyewitnesses. |
| **Deed Vault** | A cryptographically verifiable repository where creators and newsrooms inspect, track, and manage all active, pending, and settled digital deeds and licences. |
| **Ephemeral Messenger** | An end-to-end encrypted communication channel engineered with post-quantum key encapsulation (ML-KEM 768), a 15-minute RAM-only lifetime, and deterministic memory purging. |
| **Newsroom Terminal** | A real-time desktop intelligence desk featuring configurable multi-stream columns, AI search, acoustic alert monitors, and automated wire export. |
| **Wire Exporter** | A formatting engine converting verified media packages into IPTC NewsML-G2 XML and webhook payloads compatible with major broadcast CMS systems. |
| **Provenance Invariance** | A security guarantee ensuring that unwatermarked raw source assets are permanently purged from public access once protected and sealed by the provenance pipeline. |
| **Blind ID** | A cryptographically masked session identifier that shields contributor identity while maintaining verifiable reputational provenance. |
| **C2PA Manifest** | A standardised digital provenance record injected directly into media containers to prove asset origin, capture parameters, and editorial integrity. |
